title: Zero-click Google searches (US, 2016-2026)
unit: % of US Google searches ending without a click to any website
scope: US Google searches, browser only (excludes Google's mobile search app, which SparkToro notes likely understates zero-click rates).

context.weighting: 2024 & 2026 figures use a usage-weighted blend of 2/3 mobile, 1/3 desktop (SparkToro 2026 study).
context.comparability_caveat: Providers differ by year (Jumpshot 2016/2019; Datos 2024; Similarweb 2026); SparkToro calls the cross-year comparison 'a bit of apples and oranges'.
